stops.title: Asɔre baa nhyehyɛeɛ
stops.caption: Nsɛm, berɛ, nkyerɛwee.
stops.speech: Asɔre baa kura n’adres, n’ɔsom berɛ, ne sɛ w’ankasa nkyerɛwee abue anaa ne berɛ tenten a ɛtwa ɔsom no ho hyia.

stops.title: Hwan na ɔdi anim
stops.caption: Ɔsɔfoɔ, asomfoɔ, sohwɛfoɔ.
stops.speech: Wɔde akannifoɔ ma wɔ ha: ɔsɔfoɔ panin, asomfoɔ sɛ wɔwɔ hɔ a, ne asɔre baa sohwɛfoɔ a wɔtumi hwɛ ne nsɛm so.
